title: 3 PhD positions opening at QMUL in early 2027
text: I will be recruiting three PhD students in early 2027. I am particularly looking for candidates working on Internet measurement, standardisation, governance and/or its economics. For examples of my work in these areas, see my research interests and the IRTF RASP Research Group. I am also open to ideas outside this scope. If you would like to explore potential opportunities, get in touch.
